next.reason: 1985: "The MULTIPLE FILE TAPE clause is required when more than one file shares the same physical reel of tape."; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the MULTIPLE FILE TAPE clause; no candidate covers files sharing a reel or the POSITION phrase.". No 2023 clause holds this feature. The SAME clause's one-file-open rule is about shared memory areas, not files sharing a tape reel, so the clause is dropped.
